story.soThat: one command produces the data behind a sensitivity chart

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–11. The linked-axes YAML form, set_path grammar, worker function and parquet schema in Dev Notes are normative.

dependencies.python: multiprocessing (stdlib), pandas, pyarrow. No new dependencies.

story-context.constraints: - New files: src/depeg_sim/experiments/sweep.py (+ optional src/depeg_sim/sweep.py shim), sweeps/pool-depth-x-attacker.yaml, tests/test_sweep.py, tests/test_set_path.py. Edits: summary.py, runner.py (chart flag), existing tests for the key rename, pyproject (optional). - SweepSpec is StrictModel-style (extra="forbid"); sweeps/ YAML files carry a version: 1 field. - Cells never share state; each cell gets a fresh RunContext via run_scenario. - spawn context only. No fork. - Aggregation reads summary.json from disk, not the in-memory return, for workers > 1 (so the parquet is built from the same files a reader would see). - sweep.parquet sorted by index; byte-identical across worker counts. - No chart generation inside sweeps. - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: version: Literal[1]; name: str; base: Path; linked_axes: list[LinkedAxis] = []; axes: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}; seeds: list[int]; overrides: dict[str, Any] = {}; max_steps: int | None = None
name: str; paths: list[str] (min 1); values: list[Any]
index: int; seed: int; axis_values: dict[str, Any]; config: ScenarioConfig
set_path(cfg: ScenarioConfig, path: str, value: Any) -> ScenarioConfig ; raises SweepPathError
expand(spec: SweepSpec) -> list[SweepCell] ; raises SweepSpecError on the ADR-0013 guard
run_sweep(spec: SweepSpec, output_dir: Path, workers: int = 1) -> Path (the sweep directory)
run_scenario(cfg, *, seed_override=None, output_dir, chart: bool = True) -> RunArtifacts

tests.standards: pytest; tmp_path for outputs; sweep tests use max_steps overrides of 100–300 to stay fast; the workers=1 vs workers=2 byte test is the only multi-process test and must pass on CI's 2-core runner.
